_doc: Render budget for tests/client_smoke/render_budget.py (art bible section 7). art_bible: the targets. ceilings: what fails the Test check today. On 2026-11-23 the spawn shot was already over two targets, so those ceilings are today's number with a little room (primitives measured 1,980,677 noon / 1,981,697 night, about 3x the scene's ~580k triangles because the sun's shadow passes draw the scene again; 30 distinct materials in the world as built, avatars not counted). Ceilings only go down: world lowers them when it slims the world. baseline: the worst frame per shot on 2026-11-23 (llvmpipe, 1280x720); a PR that raises draw calls or primitives more than `regression` over it fails.
